summary: Based on evidence through 13 Jan 2025, no new conditions justify altering the existing covenant package; all clauses remain appropriate.

clauses.rationale: No evidence shows the Minimum Core Assets Test threshold or triggers need adjustment; the Amazon Break Fee received exceeds thresholds that would trigger step‑up.
Financial statements continue to be delivered; no going‑concern qualifications or reporting issues appear in the evidence.
Monthly compliance certificates and related deliverables are being provided as required; no evidence of failure or need to change frequency.
The Amazon Break Fee sweep provisions align with the observed $94 million termination fee usage; no new evidence warrants a change.
No defaults or events of default have been reported; the notice provision remains adequate.

drift_reasons: All covenant clauses are supported by current evidence; no tightened, loosened, or new protections are required.
